TGT-005.notes: PDF ingestion now has an explicit opt-in OCR fallback. It runs only when native PDF text is absent, preserves the original PDF byte identity, promotes only report-bound page OCR raw text, and records report identity, page/span accounting, and structured failure residue. Representative document accuracy, independent confidence calibration, handwriting, broad table/form semantics, provider privacy policy, and hosted/current-head evidence remain open.

MATRIX-006.notes: The local ingestion boundary now has positive and negative OCR integration gates in addition to the synthetic OCR runtime and PDF page-lineage receipts. This does not close the broader OCR/document benchmark: independently authored representative labels, real-document breadth, and mismatch adjudication remain unresolved.

N08.notes: N08 advanced from OPEN to PROVISIONAL for the bounded local ingestion boundary. OCR is now explicitly wired into scanned-PDF ingestion behind a runtime setting with report-bound text promotion and fail-closed errors. Broad document-intelligence and frozen representative-corpus evidence remain open.
